description: This Java class 'VariableRegistry' manages variable definitions, including registration, variable substitution, and code generation for constants. It maintains a singleton instance, handles integer and string variables, and generates header files and Java constants.

classes.name: VariableRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class extending TreeMap to manage variable definitions, substitutions, and code generation for configuration variables.

methods.name: applyVariables
methods.description: Replaces variable references like @@var@@ in a string with their actual values, throwing an exception if a variable is undefined.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a variable with a string value, updating internal definitions and attempting to register as an integer if applicable.

methods.name: tryToRegisterAsInteger
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string value as an integer and registers it as a constant; if not an integer, registers as a string constant.

methods.name: isQuoted
methods.description: Checks if a string value is quoted with double quotes.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Overloaded method to register an integer variable and its hexadecimal equivalent.

methods.name: writeNumericsToFile
methods.description: Writes all registered numeric variables to a header file.

methods.name: getJavaConstants
methods.description: Returns a concatenation of all Java constant definitions for registered variables.
